jarvis_projects.description: Developed a data analytics proof of concept by performing data cleaning, transformation, and exploratory analysis on raw datasets using Python with Pandas and NumPy. jarvis_projects.description: Built an interactive Power BI dashboard using survey data from data professionals around the world to better understand industry trends, salary patterns, programming preferences, and overall job satisfaction. Worked with raw survey data to clean, organize, and visualize meaningful insights through charts, KPIs, gauges, and treemaps. The dashboard helped compare salaries across different roles, analyze country-wise demographics, and identify popular programming languages among professionals. Focused on creating a clear and user-friendly dashboard that supports better understanding of trends in the data industry through interactive and data-driven reporting.

jarvis_projects.description: Developed a stock analytics dashboard in Power BI by integrating financial data from Alpha Vantage using REST APIs. Built end-to-end data pipelines in Power Query (M language) to extract, parse, and transform both JSON and CSV responses, including handling schema inconsistencies and null values. Engineered reusable and parameterized queries to dynamically support multiple stock tickers. Designed advanced DAX measures using CALCULATE, FILTER, and time intelligence functions to compute key financial metrics such as 52-week high/low, market capitalization, and analyst estimates. Created interactive and visually rich dashboards with combined line and column charts for price and volume analysis, along with KPI cards and earnings comparisons. Implemented slicers and dynamic measures to enable user-driven time-based filtering, delivering a scalable and responsive business intelligence solution for financial data analysis.
jarvis_projects.name: Real time Stock Analytics Dashboard

jarvis_projects.description: Developed a data-driven credit limit optimization framework to assess customer spending behaviour and evaluate whether assigned credit limits were aligned with actual utilization patterns. The project involved analysing transaction, card, and customer datasets to segment users into low, moderate, and high utilization categories, enabling targeted and behaviour-based credit allocation strategies. Identified significant underutilized credit exposure across the portfolio and proposed optimization opportunities to reduce idle capital, improve lending efficiency, and minimize unnecessary risk. Delivered strategic business recommendations focused on dynamic credit limit adjustment, high-value customer expansion, segment-based credit policies, and smarter capital allocation using Python-based analytics and interactive Power BI dashboards.
jarvis_projects.name: Credit Limit Optimization Analysis Project

jarvis_projects.description: Worked on a data project using Spark and Databricks where I extracted data from files, APIs, and databases, and transformed it using joins, filters, and aggregations. This project helped me understand how to work with large data and turn it into meaningful insights.
jarvis_projects.name: Data Processing & Analysis using Spark and Databricks

Built visualizations to assess regional performance, track monthly sales trends, and highlight top-performing products. Implemented filters and dashboard actions to enable dynamic user interaction and deeper data exploration. Focused on delivering a clean, structured layout to present insights effectively and support data-driven decision-making.
jarvis_projects.name: Beverage Sales Performance Dashboard (Tableau)
